messages:
carmen: Heads-up — onboarding a new cross-tenant service that needs to wrap/unwrap DEKs in Azure Key Vault. Questions: managed identity patterns across tenant boundaries? RBAC vs access policies? any gotchas for envelope encryption and rotation?

ben: short answer: prefer RBAC for new workflows, but you still need data-plane crypto permissions (wrapKey/unwrapKey) via roles. cross-tenant adds a few extra steps.

dmitri: +1. For cross-tenant the typical options are:
- create a service principal in the target tenant for the app (preferred)
- OR invite the app's service principal as a guest (less ideal)
Either way the principal needs a KV role assignment for crypto operations.

alice: note — if the vault uses Access Policies (legacy) you'll need to switch to RBAC or use access-policy grants. AKV can be in RBAC mode or have access policies; they don't mix well.

carmen: hmm the app team wants to use their existing managed identity from tenant A to access vault in tenant B. Is federation possible?

dmitri: you can use workload identity federation (OIDC) to mint tokens in the target tenant, but it's more infra. Practically we create a short-lived service principal in tenant B and provision a client secret/cert or federated cred for the pipeline. Avoid long-lived creds.

ben: operational notes:
- Role to assign: "Key Vault Crypto Service Encryption User" or a custom role with Microsoft.KeyVault/crypto/wrap/action and /unwrap/action.
- For envelope encryption, the app should call wrapKey/unwrapKey, not sign/verify.

alice: audit logging / detection: enable diagnostic settings to stream to Log Analytics + Event Hub (for SIEM). The AzureActivity and KeyVaultAuditEvents will show wrap/unwrap ops. Example:
```
az monitor diagnostic-settings create --name kv-diag --resource /subscriptions/xxx/resourceGroups/rg/providers/Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/my-vault --workspace /subscriptions/xxx/resourcegroups/rg/providers/Microsoft.OperationalInsights/workspaces/myla
```

deploy-bot: failing call in prod this morning — 403 from KV when trying to unwrap a data key. log snippet: 
```
403 Forbidden: Operation 'Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/decrypt/action' not authorized for principal 'spn:abcd-...'
```

alice: common root causes for 403: role assignment not in same scope (you can assign at vault or subscription), role propagation delay (~30s-2min), or using access policies while RBAC is enforced. Also check firewall/private endpoint.

carmen: rotation plan question — do we rewrap all DEKs immediately or lazy rotate?

dmitri: lazy rotate is usually safer: create new key version in KV, update new DEKs to use new KEK on write. For existing objects, rewrap on read/write window or a background job that rewraps in batches. Ensure you track key version metadata with the wrapped DEK (store kek_version).

ben: operational checklist:
- enable soft-delete + purge protection on vault
- enable diagnostic settings to LA/event hub
- document role bindings with object ids and principal type
- automate key rotation: create new version, test unwrap with new version, then roll background rewrap

security-bot: reminder: audit rule triggered for cross-tenant role assignment change at 2026-03-17T10:12:03Z. Link: https://console.redwood.internal/logs/abcd

carmen: action items: @dmitri to propose RBAC role JSON for ops, @alice to add diag setting to onboarding playbook, @ben to verify private endpoint access for the service. I'll coordinate with app team about creating the SP in tenant B.

dmitri: putting draft role snippet here (custom role minimal):
```
{
  "Name": "KV-wrap-unwrap-minimal",
  "Actions": [
    "Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/deploy/action",
    "Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/wrap/action",
    "Microsoft.KeyVault/vaults/keys/unwrap/action"
  ],
  "NotActions": [],
  "AssignableScopes": ["/subscriptions/0000-0000-0000"]
}
```

alice: thanks. i'll update the playbook and add step to record kek_version per object.

ben: also add a test in our e2e: simulate role-assignment + validate wrap/unwrap then revoke and ensure we get 403. quick check prevents surprises. :thumbsup:

carmen: great — looks actionable. will update thread with the tenant SP details once created.
